name: Flaws
description: A d100 table of flaws related to The Veil of Crimson Blood campaign's central themes of memory and metaphysical decay.

results.description: A Fragmented Past: You have gaps in your memory. Important moments and people from your past feel like they belong to a stranger.
The Whispering Blight: You are susceptible to the Blight's influence. It whispers forgotten memories and half-truths in your mind.
Haunted by Lyra's Fate: The search for Lyra has become an obsession. You see parallels between her disappearance and every missing person case.
Vespera's Echo: You sometimes hear echoes of Vespera's ancient conflict, causing moments of cosmic dread and paralysis.
The Burden of Fading Memories: You are overly attached to mementos, fearing that if you lose them, you will lose a part of yourself.
Distrust of Knowledge: You have an inherent distrust of ancient lore and history, believing it to be corrupted by time and the Blight.
The False Memory: You cling to a vivid memory that, upon closer inspection, doesn't seem to belong to you at all.
Chronic Fear of Erasure: You are terrified of being forgotten. You obsessively leave behind markers or signs of your existence.
Impulsive Recklessness: Your personal history is a blank slate, so you act on impulse, believing you have nothing to lose.
The Memory Thief: You are a 'sponge' for the Blight's effects, sometimes absorbing the fading memories of those around you.
Blight-Fueled Nightmares: Your dreams are a chaotic jumble of corrupted images and forgotten histories, leaving you exhausted and anxious.
The Unseen Stain: You are convinced there is a metaphorical stain on your soul from a past you can't recall, making you feel unworthy of connection.
Fear of Stagnation: You constantly seek change and new experiences, fearing that if you stand still for too long, you will begin to fade away.
The Unreliable Narrator: You often change details when telling stories, not out of malice but because your memories are inconsistent and unreliable.
A Debt Owed: You feel you owe a great debt to someone from your past, but you have no idea who they are or what the debt is for.
Unhinged Laughter: You sometimes laugh at inappropriate times, triggered by a fleeting, incomprehensible memory of something tragic or humorous.
The Absent Friend: You have an intense, recurring feeling that you have a close friend or companion who is now gone, but you can't remember their name.
Aversion to Mirrors: Seeing your own reflection makes you uncomfortable, as if you are looking at a stranger you should know.
Compulsive Hoarder: You compulsively collect seemingly worthless items, each one a tiny, fragile anchor to a past you can't recall.
The Fickle Mind: Your opinion on people and situations can change on a whim, as your core beliefs are not yet fully formed.
The Living Anachronism: You have a deep-seated feeling that you are from a different time, and modern customs feel foreign to you.
Unspoken Guilt: You carry an immense sense of guilt for an event you can't remember, causing you to take responsibility for others' mistakes.
Fear of Symbols: You have an irrational fear of certain symbols or sigils, especially the spiral that represents Vespera's work.
The Overly Trusting Soul: Because your memories are unreliable, you take what others say at face value, making you easy to manipulate.
The Burden of the Void: You feel an emptiness within you, a void where your past should be, which you constantly try to fill with distractions.
The Blight's Mark: A faint, silvery scar appeared one day on your skin. It has no source you can remember and sometimes it tingles, as if in sympathy with some unseen force.
Incessant Humming: You sometimes hum a tune you don't know, a melody you are sure is not your own, and it is impossible to stop until it fades on its own.
An Unfinished Story: You started writing a journal of your past but can't find the motivation to complete it. Every time you try, you feel a deep, unshakable melancholy.
The Borrowed Memory: You have a vivid memory of another person's joyous or tragic experience, which you believe is your own. The emotional impact is real, but the details are not yours.
The Shadow Follower: You have a strong feeling that you are being followed, not by a person, but by a shadow of your own lost self. It's unnerving and causes paranoia.
The Ghost Limb: You feel a profound sense of loss for something you don't even know you've lost. It feels like a limb you can no longer feel, and it hurts.
The Unseen Friend: You sometimes hold a conversation with an invisible friend who you believe is a companion from your past. Others think you're crazy.
The Fading Photograph: You have a picture of yourself that seems to be fading. The more you look at it, the blurrier your face becomes. It's a reminder of your fragility.
The Ticking Clock: You are convinced that your time is running out. You're always in a hurry, believing that something fundamental is about to be erased from existence.
Unaccountable Skills: You possess a skill or talent you have no memory of learning, and it makes you feel like an imposter. You fear being found out.
The Unspoken Name: You have a word or name on the tip of your tongue that you can never quite remember. It is a source of constant frustration.
A Puzzling Compassion: You feel a deep, unexplainable sense of compassion for people you have just met, as if you knew them in another life.
The Mute Witness: You have a clear memory of witnessing a terrible event, but you cannot speak about it. The words are physically stuck in your throat.
The Coded Message: You find yourself writing or drawing strange, nonsensical symbols. You don't know what they mean, but they feel like a code from your past.
The Missing Key: You compulsively search for a key that you believe will unlock your memories, but you don't know what the key looks like or what it's for.
The Unseen Wall: There's a subject you can't talk about. When someone brings it up, a physical barrier seems to form in your mind, preventing you from speaking.
The Ghost of a Smile: You often catch yourself smiling at things that aren't funny, a phantom smile from a happier memory that you can't recall.
The Lingering Scent: You are haunted by a particular scent, a mix of old books and something metallic, that you can't place. It evokes a strong sense of danger.
The Echoing Voice: You sometimes hear a voice in your head that you think is your own, but it says things that you would never say.
The Fragmented Map: You feel a strong pull to go to places you've never been. You believe you have an incomplete map of your life, and you need to find the missing pieces.
The Unsettling Familiarity: Certain places and people feel uncomfortably familiar, as if you've seen them before in a dream, and it makes you uneasy.
A Broken Promise: You have a profound sense of having broken a promise to someone you loved, but you don't know what the promise was.
The Mnemonic Parasite: You feel like your memories are being leeched from you, and it causes a constant, low-grade headache.
The Self-Fulfilling Prophecy: You have a fear that a certain event will happen, and you unconsciously act in ways that make it more likely to occur.
The Anxious Collector: You constantly collect things, not for their value, but because you fear they will be forgotten if you don't.
The Disconnected Soul: You feel a deep sense of apathy towards most things, as if you are a spectator in your own life.
The Wandering Gaze: Your eyes are always darting, as if you are searching for someone or something you can't see.
The Lost Melody: You are tormented by a beautiful melody you can only hum a part of. The rest of the tune is lost to you, and it's a source of great sorrow.
The Disembodied Laughter: You hear your own laugh, but it doesn't sound like it's coming from you. It's a hollow, distant sound, like an echo from a past you don't remember.
The Unending Quest: You are driven to complete a quest that you don't remember starting. You feel an immense pressure to find something, but you don't know what it is.
The Forgotten Language: You sometimes find yourself speaking in a language you don't know. The words feel meaningful, but you can't comprehend them.
The Silent Scream: You have a memory of a scream that you can't get out of your head. It's a silent scream, and it causes you to feel a deep sense of despair.
The Crying Scent: You sometimes smell a scent that makes you inexplicably sad. It smells like wet earth and something sweet, like a flower that's no longer there.
The Burden of the Past: You feel like you are carrying a burden that isn't yours. It's a heavy, invisible weight that makes every step more difficult.
The Unwieldy Tool: You have a specific item that you feel you're meant to use, but you don't know how. It feels like an extension of yourself, but one you can't control.
The Echoing Pain: You feel a physical pain that isn't real. It's an echo of a pain from your past, and it can cripple you in moments of stress.
The Lost Home: You feel a deep longing for a home you can't remember. You are always searching for a place that feels like it belongs to you.
The Perpetual Ghost: You feel like you are a ghost in your own life. You are there, but you are not really 'there' in the moment.
The Unfinished Symphony: You are a musician, but you can only play incomplete pieces. The last few notes are always lost to you, a tormenting reminder of your fragmented self.
The Fading Friend: You have a friend you are trying to remember, but their face is fading from your mind. It's a race against time to hold on to them.
The Broken Compass: Your sense of direction is terrible. You often get lost, not because you don't know where you are, but because you feel pulled in all directions by unseen forces.
The Unreliable Reflection: Your reflection in the water sometimes seems to show a different person. It's a subtle change, but it's enough to make you doubt your own identity.
The Missing Puzzle Piece: You have a profound sense that there is a missing piece to your life, and you feel a compulsion to find it, no matter the cost.
The Living Anomaly: You are a living contradiction. You feel like you should be one thing, but you are another. This causes a constant internal conflict.
The Unspoken Lie: You have a deep-seated fear that you have told a great lie in your past, and it's on the verge of being discovered.
The Unsent Letter: You feel an immense need to write a letter to someone, but you don't know who. The words are there, but the address is lost to you.
The Silent Observer: You are always watching, but you feel like you are not a part of what's happening. It's a strange detachment that makes you feel lonely.
The Empty Locket: You wear a locket that you can't open. You feel like it holds a secret to your past, but the mechanism is gone.
The Unending Dream: You are convinced that you are living in a dream and that you will wake up one day to a different life. It's a comforting but also terrifying thought.
The Missing Child: You feel a profound sense of loss for a child you can't remember. It's an ache in your heart that you can't explain.
The Unfamiliar Scent: You sometimes smell a scent that you can't place. It's a smell of something from another time, and it makes you feel like you don't belong.
The Broken Promise: You are haunted by a promise you feel you've broken. You don't know what it was, but you know you failed someone important.
The Unfamiliar Hand: You sometimes look at your own hand and feel like it's not yours. It's a strange, disquieting feeling.
The Unremembered Lover: You have a profound sense of having lost a lover you can't remember. It's a source of a deep, unexplainable sadness.
The Fragmented Soul: You feel like your soul has been broken into pieces, and you are always searching for the parts that are missing.
The Cursed Object: You are drawn to a seemingly harmless object that you can't part with. It's a constant reminder of something you've lost, but you don't know what.
The Unending Search: You are always searching for something. You don't know what it is, but the search itself is what drives you.
The Forgotten Art: You have a skill for an art form that you don't remember learning. It's a source of both pride and confusion.
The Mute Witness: You remember witnessing a terrible event, but you are physically unable to speak about it. The words are stuck in your throat.
